main_text.l: O. Animalium interius sentientium, Membra organica communia partium sunt
Truncus, Spina dorsi insistens. Ex qua oriuntur

page.notes: The label "Ossea : scil." is printed vertically beside its brace. The bullets after "Membrana", "Membranosa", "Viscera" and "Membrana." are typographic dots, not text. The line "Truncus, Spina dorsi insistens. Ex qua oriuntur" is set with a broken word at the line ends, joined here. "tũ" is printed with a tilde over u, read as tum.
